text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a little bit... I had a long night
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I went to a store that has all kinds of
cool stuff
and bought a disco ball for my
house.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Unsurprisingly, I developed a severe
case of disco
fever and ended up
dancing all night...
